knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The roles on paper are not the problem here. An out-of-date allocation sheet is a systems fault.
Trust lets people raise problems early and make hard calls faster. It does not replace checklists, the lead's sign-off or the business's procedures.
A new lead applies the agreed standard steadily, communicates the plan and builds trust through consistent behaviour over time.

practicalCriteria: The learner diagnoses a supplied misalignment case, names the level and gives the evidence used.
The learner chooses one fix, states a check date and a measure, and records the result after the check.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and refer any roster or role change that would alter a worker's pay or entitlements without the business's approval.
Stop and refer any misalignment that involves an unsafe method on site.
